projects.title: FouadHoussien LMS Platform
projects.description: Online academy for courses, coaching, and digital learning with payments and certificates.
projects.longDescription: Designed and developed a complete native Laravel-based learning and business platform for Fouad Houssien. The system combines a public marketing website, course catalog, and service presentation with a full LMS engine, integrated AI chatbot experience, secure video learning delivery via Bunny, and online payments through Paymob and Fawaterak. Built a complete CMS with role-based control, including admin dashboard and user dashboard for course progress tracking, quiz workflows, assignment handling, grading, and certificate management. The architecture focuses on scalability, clean UX, content control, and conversion-ready learning funnels.
features: Admin Dashboard with Full CMS Controls
Services, Courses, and Conversion-Focused Public Pages
challenges: Combining CMS, LMS, and marketing website in one maintainable architecture
Building smooth user journeys across discovery, enrollment, and course completion
Handling secure video delivery and playback performance at scale
Integrating multiple payment gateways with reliable success/failure handling
Designing robust quiz and assignment tracking with grading logic
Maintaining clear role separation between admin operations and learner experience
solutions: Modular Laravel architecture with clear domain separation
Structured dashboards for admins and learners with role-based permissions
Bunny-powered media delivery with optimized loading and playback
Unified checkout/payment logic supporting Paymob and Fawaterak
Assessment pipeline for quizzes, assignments, grading, and certificates
CMS-driven content model for scalable updates without developer dependency

projects.title: Travel & Tourism Blogging Website
projects.description: Travel and tourism news blog with Arabic and English content.
projects.longDescription: Developed a comprehensive WordPress blogging website for Syyaha, a travel and tourism news platform. Built using JNews theme with TranslatePress for full Arabic/English bilingual support. Created a custom WordPress plugin that tracks posts by language using custom fields, allowing posts to be marked as Arabic or English. The plugin tracks and displays the count of Arabic and English posts, and enables filtering posts by language. The website features comprehensive travel content including destinations, hotels, airlines, travel technology, medical tourism, restaurants, and travel news, with full RTL support for Arabic content.
challenges: Custom plugin development for language tracking
Custom field integration for post language classification
solutions: Custom WordPress plugin with language tracking functionality
Custom field implementation for post language metadata
RTL CSS implementation for Arabic content
Database queries for post count tracking
